articles.title: Platform purpose
articles.intro: Unseen hosts independent photography and music championships: 16 participants, single elimination and votes from the registered community.

articles.title: Submissions and selection
articles.intro: Submit a photograph or a song with its cover. The team approves entries and selects 16 different participants for each championship. Initial seeds and pairings are public before the start.

articles.title: Championship schedule
articles.intro: Each championship lasts exactly 720 hours (30 days). One match is played at a time for 48 hours: 8 round-of-16 matches, 4 quarterfinals, 2 semifinals and 1 final. The administrator sets the start; all subsequent times are automatic.

articles.title: Voting and advancement
articles.intro: You must be logged in to vote. Each account may vote once per match during its 48-hour window. The entry with more votes advances. Ties, including zero votes, are decided by initial seed: #1 takes priority over #2, and so on.

articles.title: Bracket and winner
articles.intro: The Championship section displays the 16 entries, results and schedule. Winners fill the next round; eliminated entries are darkened and marked with an X. The final winner is the champion. The Gallery retains team-curated collections and historical awards.

articles.title: Fair play and anti-bot
articles.intro: Only registered users may vote, with one vote per duel. Bots, fake or duplicate accounts, automated scripts and artificial vote exchanges are forbidden; suspicious votes may be cancelled.

articles.title: Copyright and usage licence
articles.intro: The author keeps full copyright. By uploading a photo, the author grants Unseen a free, non-exclusive licence to display and promote it with credit, without any sale or transfer to third parties without written permission.
